evidence_spans.quote: Deep Portfolio Management A Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for the Financial Portfolio Management Problem
This paper presents a ﬁnancial-model- free Reinforcement Learn- ing framework to provide a deep machine learning solution to the port folio management problem.
examined in three back-test experiments with a trading period of 30 minutes in a cryptocurrency mar- ket.
number of assets 12 Total number of preselected assets (including the cash, Bitcoin). (Section 3.1)
Prices are accessed in periods of 30 minut es.
trading period (second) 1800 Time interval between two portfolio redistributions. (Section 2.1)

At the end of Period t + 1, the logarithmic rate of return for the period due to decis ion wt can be calculated with the additional information from the price change vecto r yt+1, using Equation (10), rt+1 = ln( µ t+1yt+1 · wt). In the language of RL, rt+1 is the immediate reward to the portfolio management agent for its action wt under environment condition Xt.
All price data is accesse d with Poloniex’s oﬃcial Application Programming Interface (API)
Closing prices are used for cross validation and back-tests, while highest, lo west, and closing prices in the periods are used for training.
window size 50 Number of the columns (number of the trading periods) in each input price matrix. (Section 3.2)
The framework is real- ized in three instants in this work with a Convolutional Neural Networ k (CNN), a basic Re- current Neural Network (RNN), and a Long Short-Term Memory ( LSTM).
total steps 2 × 106 Total number of steps for pre-training in the training set.
batch size 50 Size of mini-batch during training. (Section 3.1)
learning rate 3 × 10−5 Parameter α (i.e. the step size) of the Adam optimization (Kingma and Ba, 2014).
A cross validation set is used f or determination of the hyper- parameters, whose range is also listed.
The performance metrics are Maximum Drawdown (MDD), the ﬁnal Accumulated Po rtfolio Value (fAPV) in the unit of initial portfolio amount ( pf /p 0), and the Sharpe ratio (SR).
In term of fAPV or SR, the best performing algorithm in Back-Tes t 1 and 2 is the CNN EIIE whose ﬁnal wealth is more than twice of the runner-up in the ﬁr st experiment.
Although with a high commission rate of 0. 25% in the back- tests, the framework is able to achieve at least 4-fold returns in 50 days.

method_cards.training_protocol: Train the SDF model on 1967-1986 data, tune hyperparameters on 1987-1991 validation data by maximizing the validation Sharpe ratio of the SDF, and evaluate the selected model on 1992-2016 test data. Neural-network models are ensembled by averaging outputs from nine fits with the same architecture and different optimization starting values. The optimal reported GAN configuration has two layers, four economic states, and eight conditioning instruments for the test assets. method_cards.task_type: cross-sectional binary directional movement forecasting for intraday trading
method_cards.frequency: daily trading days with intraday return target
method_cards.horizon: same trading day intraday return direction relative to cross-sectional median
method_cards.label_definition: For each stock at time t, Class 0 if its intraday return is smaller than the cross-sectional median intraday return of all stocks at time t; Class 1 if its intraday return is bigger than the cross-sectional median intraday return of all stocks at time t.
data_requirements: Daily data for constituent stocks of the S&P 500 from January 1993 through December 2018.
Opening prices and closing prices sufficient to compute returns with respect to closing prices, returns with respect to opening prices, and intraday returns.
For each study window, construct per-stock feature matrices, remove the first 240 partially filled rows, and concatenate training data across all stocks in S.
At each trading day, compute cross-sectional median intraday return across all stocks to form binary labels.
method_cards.training_protocol: Within a typical study window with Tstudy = 1008 rows, remove the first 240 rows because lagged returns are partially undefined; split remaining rows chronologically with approximately t = 241 to t = 756 for training and t = 757 to t = Tstudy for testing/trading. Concatenate training data for all stocks in S, yielding approximately 500 x 516 = 258000 training instances and 500 x 252 = 126000 trading instances. LSTM uses CuDNNLSTM. Optimizer, loss, batch size, number of epochs, random seed, validation protocol, and early stopping are unknown from the supplied context.
method_cards.evaluation_protocol: Evaluate the 3-Feature IntraDay LSTM row on the trading/test portion. The trading strategy buys the 10 stocks with the highest predicted probability and sells short the 10 stocks with the lowest predicted probability each trading day, with equal monetary weight, and reports daily returns before transaction costs. The exact outer rolling-window schedule over 1993-2018 is unknown from the supplied context.
